font.family: Lalezar (HalationBloom headline, SpotlightSweepReveal title); Estedad 800 (SheenSweepRetry card); Vazirmatn 600 (halation kicker)
font.reason: Heavy Helvetica 800 slam headlines map to the single-weight poster face Lalezar (no fake bold, wordSpacing .15em to keep the word gap); the card UI uses Estedad, a neutral variable face that really has weight 800; the small kicker uses neutral Vazirmatn.

comps.translatedSummary: «۱۰ برابر» crash-zooms in, a blurred bright halo pops and settles; kicker «هالهٔ نور».

rtlDecisions.why: Radially symmetric about the centre; no reading direction. Timeline, easings, blur 22px and brightness 1.8 unchanged.
Symmetric composition; halo is a copy of the same Persian TextBlock so glyph shapes bloom correctly.
Idiomatic ten-fold claim with Persian digits; direction:rtl so the order reads right to left.
Tracking breaks Persian joining; removed, hierarchy kept with size and colour.
Source untouched; inspected beats with the harness --duration 145.

comps.translatedSummary: A dark card titled «پرو» with two placeholder bars; one diagonal sheen band sweeps across once (frames 40-68).

rtlDecisions.why: A wipe/sweep follows reading direction: band anchored right:0 with translateX(dir(x)), entering from the right edge and exiting left; same distance, easing and frames.
245deg keeps the 45deg lean of the band mirrored with the travel direction.
direction:rtl puts content on the start (right) edge; padding is symmetric so the card still looks balanced.
Persian spelling of the tier; letter spacing breaks joining.

comps.translatedSummary: Dim title «در کانون / توجه» is revealed by a swinging spotlight (two round trips), then settles fully bright.

rtlDecisions.why: The first pass now moves toward the reading side (right to left) via dir(AMP*sin); beam still ends centred at f110. Period 55f and amplitude unchanged.

rtlDecisions.what: Light cone, radial spot, mask and vertical gradient
rtlDecisions.why: Radially symmetric light physics; they follow the same x.
Idiom 'in the spotlight'; two lines preserved, all three layers render the same joined string (no per-letter splitting).
Spacing removed (breaks joining); line-height 1.5 so dots and descenders are not clipped by the mask.

rasterTextHandling: No raster or video assets in this card; nothing baked into images.
concerns: HalationBloom registry duration is 17f while the design is 145f; verified later beats with --duration 145 (the full video render succeeded).
Lalezar renders the Persian zero as a circle (reads fine as ۱۰ at headline size).
lessons: Lights/sweeps with a diagonal gradient: mirroring the travel direction also needs the gradient angle mirrored (θ -> 360-θ), and the band anchored on the opposite edge (right:0 + translateX(dir(x))) so the start/end offsets stay symmetric.
Spotlight/sine swings: flip the phase with dir() so the first pass goes toward the reading side; the end position (centre) is unchanged because sin returns to 0.
